idea-plugin.name: Loctree
idea-plugin.description:
One-shot full repository context for AI agents, powered by the loctree-lsp server.

The plugin starts the native loctree language server for supported files (TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Python, Go) and surfaces pushed diagnostics, advertised code actions and opt-in code lenses, plus Loctree-specific tooling: Context Pack cards, literal occurrences, symbol bodies, impact analysis, holographic slices, and secondary findings. Standard hover, go-to-definition and references remain owned by the IDE's native language providers; loctree-lsp does not advertise those providers.

Requires a paid JetBrains IDE on the 2025.2.1+ line — IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, WebStorm, PyCharm Professional, GoLand, RustRover, Rider, PhpStorm, RubyMine, or CLion. Community editions do not ship the native LSP module this plugin depends on.

Supported platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux x64. The loctree-lsp runtime is downloaded once for your platform from GitHub Releases with a mandatory SHA256 check, then cached by the IDE; a local server path can be set instead. On other platforms the plugin shows a notification pointing at the manual install path.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.14.2

Initial Marketplace release.

  • Native IntelliJ LSP integration for the loctree-lsp server: pushed diagnostics, code actions and opt-in code lenses for TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Python, and Go.
  • Loctree tool window with routed query modes — Health, Find, Literal, Body, Follow, Slice, Impact, Context Atlas, Context Pack, Workspaces, Diff, AICX, Semantic, and AST Query — with rich JSON results and Load More continuation.
  • Verified runtime resolution: configured path → IDE cache → verified download (mandatory SHA256, fail-closed) → PATH. Downloads are pinned to the plugin's own version by default; latest is an explicit opt-in.
  • Honest platform matrix: downloads target only the published loctree-lsp binaries (macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64). On other platforms the plugin shows a notification with the manual install path instead of failing silently.
  • Settings under Tools → Loctree, status bar widget, and a findings tool window for dead exports, circular imports, and twins with double-click navigation.
  • Editor and project-view context actions: Refresh, Show Health, Analyze Impact, Show Slice, Find Consumers/Importers, Check Dead Exports, Show/Analyze Cycles, Find Literal Occurrences, Open Report.
  • Light and dark plugin icons sized to the Marketplace spec.
  • Compatibility: paid JetBrains IDEs 2025.2.1+ (native LSP module).
